UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a merchant user within the AntiPay system. This entity links all user-specific data, assuming external authentication.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The email address associated with the user's account.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

webhookUrl.description: Optional URL for receiving system webhooks and notifications.

Store.title: Store
Store.description: Details about a merchant's store, associated with an API key and user, used for branding and redirect purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Store entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this store belongs to. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Store)

name.description: The name of the merchant's store.

websiteUrl.description: The public website URL of the merchant's store.

logoUrl.description: URL to the store's logo image, displayed on payment pages.

supportEmail.description: Email address for customer support inquiries related to the store.

successRedirectUrl.description: URL where the user is redirected after a successful payment verification.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the store configuration was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the store configuration was last updated.

ApiKey.title: ApiKey
ApiKey.description: API keys generated by merchants to securely interact with the AntiPay system for payment sessions and verification.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ApiKey entity. This is the actual API key string.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owns this API key. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ApiKey)

storeId.description: Reference to the Store configuration associated with this API key. (Relationship: Store 1:N ApiKey)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the API key was created.

revokedAt.description: Timestamp when the API key was revoked, if applicable.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the API key is currently active and usable.

PaymentMethodConfiguration.title: PaymentMethodConfiguration
PaymentMethodConfiguration.description: User-specific settings and enablement status for various payment methods offered by the AntiPay system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PaymentMethodConfiguration entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this payment method configuration belongs to. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N PaymentMethodConfiguration)

receiverNumber.description: The receiver's account number for this payment method.

isEnabled.description: Indicates whether this payment method is enabled for the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this payment method configuration was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this payment method configuration was last updated.

PaymentSession.title: PaymentSession
PaymentSession.description: Represents a single payment request initiated by a client, awaiting user verification.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PaymentSession entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile whose API key initiated this session. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N PaymentSession)

apiKeyId.description: Reference to the ApiKey used to create this payment session. (Relationship: ApiKey 1:N PaymentSession)

amount.description: The amount expected for this payment session.

method.description: The payment method chosen for this session (e.g., 'bKash', 'Nagad', 'Rocket').

status.description: Current status of the payment session (e.g., 'pending', 'completed', 'expired', 'failed').

userProvidedTransactionId.description: The transaction ID provided by the end-user for verification.

systemMatchedTransactionId.description: Reference to the RawTransaction entity that successfully matched this session. (Relationship: PaymentSession 1:1 RawTransaction)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the payment session was created.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp when the payment session will expire if not verified.

verifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the payment session was successfully verified.

RawTransaction.title: RawTransaction
RawTransaction.description: Represents a raw, incoming transaction record (e.g., parsed from SMS) that can be used for payment verification. The `transactionId` is the actual ID from the payment provider.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RawTransaction entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this transaction belongs to. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N RawTransaction)

transactionId.description: The unique transaction ID reported by the payment provider (e.g., TRX-ABC123).

method.description: The payment method used for this transaction (e.g., 'bKash', 'Nagad', 'Rocket').

isUsedForVerification.description: Flag indicating whether this transaction has already been used to verify a payment session.

receivedAt.description: Timestamp when this raw transaction record was received by the system.

matchedPaymentSessionId.description: Reference to the PaymentSession that this raw transaction successfully verified. (Relationship: RawTransaction 1:1 PaymentSession)

Device.title: Device
Device.description: Represents a device connected by a merchant, potentially for receiving transaction SMS data or other integrations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Device entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who owns this device. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Device)

deviceName.description: A user-friendly name for the device (e.g., 'My Android Phone', 'Production Server').

lastActiveAt.description: Timestamp of the last activity recorded from this device.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the device was registered.

SubscriptionPlan.title: SubscriptionPlan
SubscriptionPlan.description: Defines the static details of an available subscription plan, including features and limits.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SubscriptionPlan entity (e.g., 'free', 'pro').

name.description: Human-readable name of the plan (e.g., 'Free Plan', 'Pro Plan').

description.description: A brief description of the subscription plan's features.

maxApiKeys.description: Maximum number of active API keys allowed for this plan.

maxDevices.description: Maximum number of connected devices allowed for this plan.

transactionLimitMonthly.description: Maximum number of transactions allowed per month for this plan.

priceMonthly.description: Monthly price of the subscription plan in the local currency (0 for free plans).

UserSubscription.title: UserSubscription
UserSubscription.description: Tracks a user's current subscription status, chosen plan, and usage against limits.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserSubscription entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile linked to this subscription. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:1 UserSubscription)

planId.description: Reference to the SubscriptionPlan the user is currently subscribed to. (Relationship: SubscriptionPlan 1:N UserSubscription)

startDate.description: The date when the current subscription period started.

endDate.description: The date when the current subscription period is scheduled to end or has ended, if applicable.

status.description: The current status of the subscription (e.g., 'active', 'cancelled', 'trial', 'expired').

currentPeriodTransactionsCount.description: Number of transactions processed in the current billing period.

currentPeriodDevicesCount.description: Number of devices currently connected/active for the user.

currentPeriodApiKeysCount.description: Number of active API keys for the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription record was last updated.

definition.description: Stores a user's profile information, linked to their Firebase Authentication UID. Access restricted to the user themselves. All other user-specific data is nested under this path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user (Firebase Auth UID).

definition.description: Configurations for a merchant's store, associated with an API key. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the owning user.

params.name: storeId
params.description: The unique identifier for the store configuration.

definition.description: API keys generated by the user. Includes denormalized 'userId' and 'storeId' for authorization independence and direct reference.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the owning user.

params.name: apiKeyId
params.description: The unique identifier for the API key, which also serves as the key string.

definition.description: User-specific payment method settings. 'paymentMethodId' could correspond to the method type (e.g., 'bKash'). Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the owning user.

params.name: paymentMethodId
params.description: The unique identifier for the payment method configuration (e.g., 'bKash').

definition.description: Full details of a payment session, owned by the merchant. This is the private, comprehensive view. Includes denormalized 'userId', 'apiKeyId', and essential 'store' (name, logo, redirect URL, support email, websiteUrl) and 'payment method' (receiverNumber) details for authorization independence when displaying session details or processing updates.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the owning user.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the payment session.

definition.description: Public-facing view of a payment session, containing only necessary data for external verification and display. Includes denormalized 'userId' (for linking), essential 'store' details (name, logo, redirect URL, support email, websiteUrl) and 'receiverNumber' (from PaymentMethodConfiguration) for authorization independence and rendering the external payment page without requiring reads from other collections.

params.name: sessionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the payment session.

definition.description: Raw incoming transaction data, typically parsed from SMS, for debugging and transparency. Includes denormalized 'userId' and 'isUsedForVerification' for security rules and integrity checks.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the owning user.

params.name: transactionId
params.description: The unique transaction ID from the payment provider.

definition.description: Connected devices for the user, potentially for receiving transaction SMS data. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the owning user.

params.name: deviceId
params.description: The unique identifier for the connected device.

definition.description: Global, read-only collection defining available subscription plans and their features/limits.

params.name: planId
params.description: The unique identifier for the subscription plan (e.g., 'free', 'pro').

definition.description: Tracks a user's active subscription plan and current usage (a single document per user). Includes denormalized 'userId' and relevant plan limits (maxApiKeys, maxDevices, transactionLimitMonthly) from 'SubscriptionPlan' for authorization independence in security rules.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the owning user.
